issue.title: Offline download queue keys on Aquifer contentId, so a re-uploaded recording (same id, new sourceUrl) is never re-fetched
issue.body:
> **Disclosure:** this issue was written and filed by an AI coding agent with permission of @JEdward7777, who heard the description of the finding but has not independently reproduced it on a device. It was noticed while doing design work on the fluent-web audio playback cards (eten-tech-foundation/fluent-web #422–#425), which touch the same Aquifer audio items the offline manifest ships. Please treat the code citations as the evidence and verify against your own understanding of the queue.

## Summary

The offline download queue is keyed on the Aquifer content id, so if Aquifer re-uploads a recording under the same content id with a different `sourceUrl`, the device never fetches the new file — the completed row wins forever.

## Where

**fluent-api** (`main` @ `76e5d01`, from merged PR eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#274) — the Prepare-Offline manifest item is built with the content id baked into the item id, alongside the URL:

- `src/domains/translation-resources/translation-resources.service.ts:332`
  `id: \`aquifer-${searchItem.id}-${kind}\``, with `sourceUrl` as a sibling field.

**fluent-mobile** (`main` @ `8707f26`):

- `src/utils/prepareOfflineQueueMapping.ts:13` — *"Uses stable `item.id` as the queue primary key"*; `:23` `id: item.id`.
- `src/db/downloadQueueRepository.ts:96–101` — `INSERT INTO download_queue (…) … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`.

So a manifest item whose `id` is unchanged but whose `sourceUrl` has changed collides with the existing (possibly `completed`) row and is silently dropped.

## Why the URL can change under a stable id

Aquifer's documentation describes versioned URLs for resource audio (a `_vNNN` suffix), but a probe on 2026-09-03 found live FIA audio URLs that carry **no** version suffix — so the URL scheme is not something the client can rely on either way, and a re-upload is best treated as "same id, new URL". Aquifer's own change signal is `GET /resources/updates`.

## Also noticed

On current `main`, `prepareOfflineQueueMapping.ts:20` still draws `sourceUrl` from `getMockDownloadSource(item.kind)` rather than from the manifest item — so the real URL is not consumed yet. That makes this a good moment to settle the key design before the real URL is wired in, rather than a live bug today.

## Possible fixes (either is enough)

1. On conflict, compare the stored `sourceUrl` with the manifest's; if they differ, reset the row to pending (upsert) instead of `DO NOTHING`.
2. Fold a hash of `sourceUrl` into the queue key so a changed URL is a new row (and let the old one be pruned).

## Not asking for

No change to the fluent-api manifest shape is being requested here — the `id` is fine as an identity; the issue is only that the queue treats identity as "contents unchanged".
